INSERT OVERWRITE TABLE mart.metric_by_segment PARTITION (dt='20260101')
WITH events_norm AS (
  SELECT segment, amount, 'A' AS branch_tag
  FROM ods.events_a
  UNION ALL
  SELECT seg_code AS segment, amount, 'B' AS branch_tag
  FROM ods.events_b
), latest_dim AS (
  SELECT segment,
         segment_name,
         ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY segment ORDER BY updated_at DESC) AS rn
  FROM dim.segment_dim
), agg AS (
  SELECT segment,
         CASE WHEN amount >= 100 THEN 'HIGH' ELSE 'LOW' END AS band,
         SUM(amount) AS total,
         COUNT(1) AS cnt
  FROM events_norm
  GROUP BY segment, CASE WHEN amount >= 100 THEN 'HIGH' ELSE 'LOW' END
), joined AS (
  SELECT a.segment, a.band, a.total, a.cnt, d.segment_name
  FROM agg a
  LEFT JOIN latest_dim d ON a.segment = d.segment AND d.rn = 1
), ranked AS (
  SELECT segment,
         band,
         total,
         cnt,
         segment_name,
         SUM(total) OVER (PARTITION BY band) AS band_total
  FROM joined
)
SELECT segment, band, total, cnt, band_total, segment_name
FROM ranked

target_metadata.ddl: CREATE TABLE mart.metric_by_segment(segment STRING COMMENT 'Segment code', band STRING COMMENT 'Amount band', total DECIMAL(18,2) COMMENT 'Summed amount', cnt BIGINT COMMENT 'Row count', band_total DECIMAL(18,2) COMMENT 'Band level total', segment_name STRING COMMENT 'Segment display name', dt STRING COMMENT 'Partition date') PARTITIONED BY (dt)
